targetMilestone.metric: continuous-song strict exact-pitch onset micro-F1 at 100 ms

hypothesis: The earlier WANE curriculum reused a model-generated Pianella target and therefore reinforced its own omissions and hallucinations. Replacing only those labels with notes extracted independently from the Pianella falling-key video should improve the opened song without changing audio, validation, optimizer, seed, or checkpoint initialization.

dataset.role: opened development and model selection; never sealed certification

independentReference.method: fixed-camera falling-note video geometry plus audio-chroma timeline alignment

control.reasonForControl: v006 has the same base model, audio curriculum, validation panel, optimizer, seed, and token weights; only WANE labels change.

singleChangedVariable.name: WANE supervision labels
singleChangedVariable.candidate: independent visual Pianella notes aligned to the original-song clock

gates: training loss must beat the immutable base on unconditioned validation
the decoded independent multi-song panel must pass without recall regression
no validation song may lose more than 0.005 absolute 100 ms F1
duration, cutoff, overlong-note, frame, and rapid-retrigger limits must pass
WANE must improve against the frozen independent visual reference
manual blind listening must confirm cleaner phrasing before deployment
rejectionPolicy: Preserve evidence but never mutate production when any automatic or manual gate fails.
